verdict.summary: The project has four distinct numeric layers: profiling-selection evidence, train3 confirmation evidence, historical construction evidence, and a separately versioned current utility-runtime authority. The current runtime authority is normal-only and fully identity-bound, but it is not the historical E1 authority and its numeric values are not proven byte-identical to historical E1 values.

numeric_layer_model.purpose: Select one target direction and horizon per source-step direction and apply the frozen train1/train2 fit gate.
Confirm the already selected direction and horizon without retuning or alternate search.
Expose reference-bound numeric construction evidence to T0/T1/T1-B/T2 while keeping values private.
Govern frozen COMMON-42 utility execution under a new normal-only numeric identity.
numeric_layer_model.selected_horizon_location: COMMON relation/rule descriptor, outside the 10-role private numeric registry

numeric_layer_model.purpose: Provide source-event census calibration only for three sources outside the nine-source COMMON relation footprint.

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Robust scale of file-local one-step source differences pooled across train1 and train2.
profiling_field_catalog.formula: max(1.4826 * MAD(file-local dx pooled across files), 1e-12)
profiling_field_catalog.use: intermediate calibration scale; not a construction or current runtime role
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: nonfinite input fails; no cross-file difference is formed

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Number of five-second pre/post median step amplitudes with amplitude strictly greater than source_noise_scale.
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: fewer than 20 produces unsupported source parameters and null threshold/tolerance

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Minimum absolute source pre/post median step amplitude accepted as an event.
profiling_field_catalog.use: profiling event extraction; historical construction binding; current runtime event qualification
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: requires at least 20 retained amplitudes; current runtime requires finite positive float

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Allowed deviation from the pre/post source median when testing sustained stability.
profiling_field_catalog.use: profiling event extraction; historical construction binding; current runtime event qualification
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: current runtime requires finite nonnegative float

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Robust scale of file-local one-step target differences, reused for all relations sharing that target.
profiling_field_catalog.formula: max(1.4826 * MAD(file-local dy pooled across files), 1e-12)
profiling_field_catalog.use: response direction classification; effect normalization; historical construction binding; current runtime response test
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: nonfinite input fails; current runtime requires finite positive float

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Count of isolated source events whose target baseline and selected-horizon response windows are complete.
profiling_field_catalog.source_split: train1/train2 separately and pooled; train3 separately during confirmation
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: right-censored windows are counted separately and never imputed

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Fraction of usable responses exceeding the target-noise threshold in the selected target direction.
profiling_field_catalog.source_split: train1, train2, pooled train1+train2, and train3 confirmation
profiling_field_catalog.formula: selected directional matches / usable responses, else 0 when usable is 0

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Fraction of usable responses exceeding the target-noise threshold in the direction opposite the selected direction.
Median of target response deltas for usable events.
profiling_field_catalog.source_split: pooled normal train1+train2 or train3 confirmation
profiling_field_catalog.use: intermediate robust effect calculation and retained evidence

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: Absolute median target response divided by target_noise_scale.
profiling_field_catalog.source_split: pooled normal train1+train2 or train3 confirmation
profiling_field_catalog.use: direction/horizon rank tie-break and fit/confirmation gates

profiling_field_catalog.meaning: One preregistered delay horizon selected during train1/train2 profiling for a directional relation.
profiling_field_catalog.use: relation semantic identity/descriptor and target response scheduling
profiling_field_catalog.missing_invalid_handling: no eligible record gives direction_unstable; train3 cannot change the selected horizon

serialization_and_integrity.historical_e1_reference: PrivateNumericBindingV1.numeric_reference hashes relation identity, role, numeric value, value origin, source/target parameter record hashes, D1 fit evidence hash, D2 confirmation evidence hash, and window constant bundle hash.
serialization_and_integrity.historical_e1_public_projection: Public manifest exposes role/reference identities and upstream hashes but excludes numeric values.
serialization_and_integrity.current_runtime_reference: new_reference_identity_v1 is value-independent and binds authority version, COMMON authority, relation binding, semantic execution hash, role, calibration policy, and normal-input identity set.
serialization_and_integrity.current_runtime_record_hash: Each private registry record additionally binds the exact numeric value and provenance identity; the registry is self-hashed and closed to exactly 420 logical keys.
serialization_and_integrity.serialization: Canonical JSON hashing is used with nonfinite values rejected; no explicit numeric rounding is applied before private record serialization.
serialization_and_integrity.custody: Private registries and locators remain outside Git; public receipts expose hashes, counts, and validation outcomes only.
stale_or_mismatched_load_prevention: exact COMMON-42 relation binding and semantic-execution hashes
runtime resolver checks exact expected main and supplement registry hashes
runtime resolver checks every rule reference against each private record reference
selected horizon checked in the canonical rule descriptor

construction_runtime_comparison.historical_construction: Eleven value-bound references per relation were materialized from frozen D1/D2 ledgers and preregistered constants. They authorized construction evidence only and explicitly denied runtime authority.
construction_runtime_comparison.current_runtime: Ten newly identified relation-bound references per relation were recalibrated from exact normal train1/train2 using the frozen method; the horizon remains in the frozen COMMON relation descriptor.
construction_runtime_comparison.identity_relationship: No historical E1 or historical registry identity was restored or reused.
construction_runtime_comparison.numeric_equality_relationship: The new values were not proven identical to historical E1; documentation explicitly forbids that claim.
construction_runtime_comparison.method_relationship: Method-continuous: the same frozen source/target calibration functions and exact normal split identities are used under a new authority version.
construction_runtime_comparison.frozen_d1_execution_authority: Frozen D1 used the audited new normal-only MAIN registry for COMMON-42 plus the six-record supplement only for full source-event census, with selected horizons from canonical rule descriptors.
construction_runtime_comparison.risk_explanation: Execution is authority-bound, but describing it as byte-identical historical construction authority would be false. The scientific result is for COMMON-42 structure under the new calibration authority.

discrepancies_and_risks.recommended_documentation: State that frozen D1 evaluates COMMON-42 executable structure under a newly versioned calibration authority.

discrepancies_and_risks.evidence: NUMERIC_ROLE_ORDER versus UTILITY_NUMERIC_ROLES and protocol-v4 rule descriptors.
discrepancies_and_risks.recommended_documentation: Show the horizon branch explicitly in numeric lineage diagrams.

discrepancies_and_risks.finding: Runtime private records do not carry a first-class unit field; units are encoded by closed role names, formulas, and exact-type checks.
discrepancies_and_risks.evidence: private registry record schema and CalibrationRoleSpecV1
discrepancies_and_risks.recommended_documentation: Document native-feature-unit versus seconds versus unitless roles; do not change frozen authority in this audit.

discrepancies_and_risks.finding: The generic CalibrationParameterV1 contract and its lag/tolerance/persistence vocabulary are not the concrete frozen D1 utility registry schema.
discrepancies_and_risks.evidence: current D1 resolver consumes the dedicated 10-role normal-only registry and canonical descriptors.
discrepancies_and_risks.recommended_documentation: Avoid implying the generic parameter registry is the frozen D1 numeric authority.

discrepancies_and_risks.finding: The six-record supplement is source-census-only and must not be counted as relation-rule numeric authority.
discrepancies_and_risks.evidence: source-census supplement purpose and final report
discrepancies_and_risks.recommended_documentation: Report 420 MAIN relation references and six supplementary census references separately.

supported: The profiling parameters and current runtime parameters derive from exact normal train1/train2 under frozen deterministic formulas.
Train3 confirmation reuses fit parameters and does not retune them.
Every current runtime role/reference has relation, method, input-identity, artifact, and hash provenance.
The frozen D1 utility runtime used the new normal-only authority rather than caller literals or LLM-proposed values.
not_supported: The current runtime registry is the historical E1 registry.
Current runtime values were proven identical to historical construction values.
The selected horizon or numeric criteria are scientifically optimal.
Relation numeric authority is the PCA-SPE detector threshold.
A normal delayed-response relation is causal or physically proven.
The current calibration generalizes to held-out data.
